name: Does She, You Know... "Like Robots"?
source:
Average Japanese high school student Tamago Akagami just can't make any friends. He can't relate to the other boys for some reason, and he is fearful of judgement from girls for his nerdier interests. One day he hears of a "Robot Stuff Club" at his new school, and goes to investigate...

[From [url=https://ohnyostudios.itch.io/does-she-like-robots]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
日本普通高中生赤神玉子交不到任何朋友。由于某种原因，他无法与其他男孩交往，并且他害怕女孩们会因为他的书呆子兴趣而评判他。有一天，他听说新学校里有一个“机器人俱乐部”，于是前去调查……

[来自[url=https://ohnyostudios.itch.io/does-she-like-robots]itch.io[/url]]
